title: Actions follow the caller's workspace role and device ownership
description: The server reports the caller's workspace role and device ownership; the web disables or hides actions the caller cannot perform and states the role it has and the role it needs, and the server's 403 names both.

steps.target: web role-gating tests and the server role matrix

assertions.target: viewer/member/owner gating and shared-device read-only view

automation.command: cd apps/web && node --test test/workspace-access.test.mjs test/workspace-overview-access.test.mjs test/devices-feature.test.mjs && cd ../server && go test ./internal/httpapi -run TestWorkspaceRolesGateActions
